Community Trust & Investment Co. lowered its position in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.8% in the fourth quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The institutional investor owned 153,236 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 4,404 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 3.2% of Community Trust & Investment Co.’s holdings, making the stock its 9th largest position. Community Trust & Investment Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $25,932,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $25,651,000 after buying an additional 167,099 shares during the last quarter. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 39.8% in the second quarter. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC now owns 69,900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $10,067,000 after buying an additional 19,900 shares during the last quarter. Rosenblatt Securities restated a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 19th. Piper Jaffray restated a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. ValuEngine upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Sunday, December 31st. Finally, UBS set a $190.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 5th. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The company has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $203.15. NASDAQ AAPL opened at $162.32 on Monday. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $183.50. The stock has a market cap of $823,613.88, a P/E ratio of 17.62, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.24 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.3 EPS for the current year.
